name: Cable Lateral Raise
summary: A standing isolation exercise targeting the lateral deltoid using a low cable pulley.

setup: Set a cable pulley to the lowest setting and attach a single D-handle.
Stand sideways to the cable machine with feet hip-width apart.
Grasp the handle with the far arm, letting the cable cross in front of your body with a slight bend in your working elbow.
steps: Raise your arm out to the side in a smooth arc until your elbow reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top to emphasize contraction on the lateral deltoid.
Lower the handle with control along the same path back to the starting position.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you raise your arm outward, and inhale as you lower the weight under control.
cues: Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Resist the weight on the way down.

common_faults.fault: Swinging the torso to generate momentum.
common_faults.correction: Brace your core and use a lighter load to isolate the shoulder.

common_faults.fault: Excessively shrugging the shoulder toward the ear.
common_faults.correction: Keep your scapula depressed and focus on reaching out wide rather than straight up.

precautions: Avoid raising the arm significantly above shoulder level if it produces anterior shoulder pinching.
